GradedRow.description:
One inherited row as a landing keeps it (S-0059/D-10): the identifier
and the grade the contract carried, which is what the `Torve-Decisions`
trailer used to say and what outlives the task directory.

grade.description: The grade the contract inherited at mint.
grade.title: Grade

id.description: The row's identifier, `S-NNNN/D-n`; local inside its own document.
id.title: Id

GradedRow.title: GradedRow

LogEntry.description:
One divergence entry as the task log carries it and a landing keeps
it (S-0057/D-7): the row it cites, what reality said, the evidence, what
the executor did. `class` is the log's key; the field is `entry_class`
because the word is Python's.

action.description: What the executor did: halted, departed or decided.
action.title: Action

at.description: The instant the entry was written (S-0058/D-7).
at.title: At

class.description: `class` in the log: discovery, spec-gap, drift or irreducible.
class.title: Class

decision.description: The row the entry cites, `S-NNNN/D-n`; local inside the row's own document.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: A `path:line` citation or a backticked command with its output (S-0005/D-4).
evidence.title: Evidence

grade.description: The row's grade as the executor read it, or UNLISTED when no document lists it.
grade.title: Grade

kind.description: What happened: contradicted, departed, resolved or blocked.
kind.title: Kind

notes.description: Anything else the reader of the log should know.
notes.title: Notes

proposal.description: The row the executor proposes for the author to append.
proposal.title: Proposal

LogEntry.title: LogEntry

description:
What one task found, kept beside the rows it informs (S-0057/D-7): the
task, its phase and attempt, the commit when the lander knew it (the
runner's rides in the candidate commit whose trailers name the task,
so it leaves the field empty), when, by whom, and the log's entries.

agent.description: Who landed it — the agent identity the runner composes, or a session.
agent.title: Agent

base.description: The commit the attempt built on, from the log's pin (S-0058/D-12).
base.title: Base

commit.description: The commit the work landed in, when the lander knew it (S-0058/D-12).
commit.title: Commit

decisions.description: The rows the contract carried, with their grades (S-0059/D-10).
decisions.title: Decisions

entries.description: The task log's entries, kept here beside the rows they cite (S-0057/D-7).
entries.title: Entries

phase.description: The phase its contract was minted from; 0 when none was.
phase.title: Phase

title: Landing
